Garden design for real families

Oakleaf Gardens designs and builds gardens across Leeds and Harrogate. We plan planting that copes with clay soil, children and dogs, and we stay with you until the first summer.

Every project starts with a free visit, a cup of tea and a walk round your garden, so we understand how you use it.

What we do

Planting plans, patios, wildlife ponds and small kitchen gardens, built by our own team.
